subject: B_A
courseName: Spreadsheets, Data Visualization, and Decision Analysis

response.courseDescription: 212 Spreadsheets, Data Visualization, and Decision Analysis Introduction to basics for using spreadsheets for data analysis and to support decision-making; principles and techniques of representing data visually in graphs, charts, and diagrams; communicating data-based results effectively; skeptical interpretation of visually represented findings when making decisions; techniques for making informed and logical decisions in a business context; introduction to spreadsheets. Credit not granted for B A 212 if credit is already earned in each of B A 204, 205, and 206.
response.coursePrerequisites: Completed 27 semester credits. Enrollment not allowed if credit already earned in each of B A 204, 205, and 206.
